abstract: One-hundred thirty-seven patients with a history or clinical evidence of cryptorchidism and testicular germinal tumor were treated at our hospital from 1934 to 1976. Cryptorchidism was corrected ipsilaterally or contralaterally in 93 patients with intrascrotal testis cancer when they were from 2 to 42 years old, either spontaneously (24 patients), by orchiopexy (58 patients), or by hormonal therapy (11 patients). Forty-four cryptorchid patients (uncorrected cases) had either ipsilateral inguinal (24 patients), or abdominal (14 patients), or contralateral intrascrotal tumors (six patients). Tumor histologic types on orchiectomy were pure seminoma in 56 patients, embryonal carcinoma in 41, teratocarcinoma in 37, and pure choriocarcinoma in 3. The five-year survival rates were similar in the corrected (61%) and uncorrected (63%) cases, and they were higher in patients with pure seminoma (79%) than in patients with germinal carcinomas (50%). The majority (64 of 80) of five-year survivors received regional lymphatic irradiation in 41 patients with pure seminoma and/or systemic chemotherapy in 23 patients with other germinomas. Since the testicular tumors that developed despite correction of the cryptorchid state were predominantly (72%) germinal carcinomas, unilateral cryptorchidism, which usually is associated with testicular atrophy, should be treated by orchiectomy instead of orchiopexy to prevent ipsilateral carcinogenesis. Cryptorchid patients with testicles that descended late should be observed periodically, especially after the 20-year latent period, for early detection of cancer.
abstract_ja: 1934年から1976年の間に当院で治療された、停留精巣の既往または臨床的所見があり精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する137例を対象とした。停留精巣は2〜42歳の時点で、自然下降（24例）、精巣固定術（58例）、またはホルモン療法（11例）により、同側または対側で矯正され、そのうち93例では精巣内に発生した精巣がんであった。停留精巣が矯正されなかった44例（非矯正例）では、同側の鼠径部腫瘍（24例）、腹腔内腫瘍（14例）、または対側の精巣内腫瘍（6例）を認めた。摘除標本の組織型は、純粋セミノーマが56例、胎児性癌が41例、奇形癌が37例、純粋絨毛癌が3例であった。5年生存率は矯正例（61%）と非矯正例（63%）で同程度であり、純粋セミノーマ（79%）は胚細胞癌（50%）より高かった。5年生存者80例のうち64例は、純粋セミノーマの41例に対する領域リンパ節照射、または他の胚細胞腫瘍の23例に対する全身化学療法を受けていた。停留精巣の矯正後に発生した精巣腫瘍は主に胚細胞癌（72%）であったため、精巣萎縮を伴う片側停留精巣は、同側の発がんを防ぐために精巣固定術ではなく精巣摘除術で治療すべきである。晩期に下降した精巣の患者では、特に20年の潜伏期以降、早期発見のため定期的な経過観察を行うべきである。
